newsitem.title: USA: EDS TO ACQUIRE NEODATA FROM HICKS MUSE.
newsitem.headline: EDS TO ACQUIRE NEODATA FROM HICKS MUSE.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp said on Thursday it plans to acquire the portion of Neodata Corp that it does not already own from Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc for $67 million, plus the assumption of debt.
EDS, which has held an equity interest in Neodata since 1990, will also assume approximately $210 million in debt, including $163 million in public debt.
The acquisition is expected to close by late August, 1997, subject to regulatory approvals.
Currently, EDS owns about 48 percent of Neodata in the form of non-voting, convertible preferred stock, a Neodata spokesman said.
Neodata generates about $300 million in annual revenues and will be combined with EDS's CustomerSolutions business, which is a direct marketing services unit.
The merged CustomerSolutions unit will employ 10,000 people and post annual revenues of $750 million, EDS said.
